_comment: Asante and Akan gold weights (abrammuo) from the Cleveland Museum of Art's open access collection, released under CC0. Each is paired with a project metric by `project` (a project slug; the metric itself lives in case-studies.json). Images are cut out of their studio backgrounds and stored in /public/art. Keep `credit` and `url` with any use of an image.
intro: For centuries in Asante, gold dust was money, and it was measured against small cast-brass weights. A royal court kept hundreds; most households kept about a dozen. These are what the work weighs.
